input: This documentation reads like it was generated. Make it sound human without changing what it says.

assertions.value: Never trade a claim for a smoother sentence
The fix for a template is not a better template
every hedging word
First person is not a license to invent
Structural sameness is the more damaging half
Rewrite a tranche, read it, and only then continue
Punchline fragment
Labeled caveat
Hedging that protects the writer
A company account is a team talking
This is an editing aid, not a detector
It never means "AI wrote this".
Never use a flag, a count or a detector score to accuse a person
Don't push them toward an arbitrary house style
Contractions, "I", humor, short sentences and typos prove nothing about who wrote a text
Flag concentration in the batch, never one outlier
Fix with substance
Never fabricate one to make copy read better
Copy in the first person needs the named author's own input
lacks clear perspective
Cratis applies it, as its own stricter policy
